newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU welcomes Italian economic plan.
newsitem.headline: EU welcomes Italian economic plan.

text.p: Italy's economic goals and reforms identified in a recent economic programme for 1998-2000 are good and appropriate, Yves Thibault de Silguy, the European Economic Affairs Commissioner, was quoted on Tuesday as saying.

But he warned that Italy's "moment of truth" regarding qualification for the EU's single currency would come in September when it is expected to adopt budgetary measures for 1998 incorporating the measures announced in the multi-annual plan.
"De Silguy said that the objectives fixed and the areas identified for budgetary reform are good and apropriate," de Silguy's spokesman quoted him as telling Italian reporters.
He was commenting on Italy's 1998-2000 economic plan.
De Silguy said the plan itself was not a guarantee that Italy would be in the first wave of countries creating the single currency.

He said the Commission would have to see whether the commitments in the plan were translated into concrete action regarding the reform of the state social security, pension and fiscal systems. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
